correctness.rationale: Every ordered pair is accounted for by reduction to the field: non-antipodal distinct residues yield an invertible nilpotent-coordinate pair map, repeated residues yield self-convolutions, and antipodal pairs create a single common zero-sum collision. Orthogonality gives exact formula (3) and direct algebra yields global deficit (1). Each summand is nonnegative using Plancherel/Young, Q>=3, and Cauchy–Schwarz. Equality is fully reconstructed from concentration on one opposite residue pair, balanced masses and single matching radical Fourier characters. Verified exact computations in 7 finite ring examples with 49 random Gaussian-integer arrays and seven equality packets. These finite checks are not an infinite proof.
